title: Little Haunts Club — Curated Scene Variations (42 Candidates)
purpose: Three deliberately designed candidate variations for each of fourteen concepts. This is an art-direction selection lab, not the final product. The existing skeleton-mermaid page 09 is held as a provisional keeper and is not regenerated.
audience: older children, teens and adults who enjoy cute cozy-spooky coloring art
visual_bible: Original cute-spooky cartoon coloring-page art: rounded chibi forms, expressive friendly faces, smooth bold black outer lines, a few clean inner lines, pure white paper, broad white coloring areas, depth shown by silhouettes and overlap, tiny black accents only, medium-large details, generous spacing, warm comic mood, simple rounded page frame, consistent hand-drawn storybook finish.
prompt_strategy: Each candidate starts with subject and action, establishes one consistent cute-spooky cartoon coloring-book style, then gives a small number of purposeful context details and a distinct composition. These prompts deliberately avoid technical rendering vocabulary and over-specified construction detail that made revision-9 pages feel overly technical.
